programmes.name: National Diploma in Computer Science
programmes.description: Comprehensive curriculum spanning algorithms, software engineering, systems design, networking, database administration, and cyber systems to produce industry-ready technologists.
requirements: 5 Credit passes in SSCE/WASSCE/NECO/GCE at not more than two sittings
Mandatory credits in English Language, Mathematics, and Physics
Two other credits from Chemistry, Biology, Agricultural Science, or Economics
Acceptable score in JAMB UTME with Computer Science or related subject combinations
programmes.duration: 2 Years (4 Semesters) Full-Time + 1 Year SIWES / IT

programmes.name: National Diploma in Electrical / Electronic Engineering
programmes.description: Practical-grounded engineering training in electronics, microprocessors, power generation, telecommunications infrastructure, instrumentation, and control systems.
requirements: 5 Credit passes at SSCE/WASSCE/NECO in English Language, Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry
One additional credit from Technical Drawing, Further Mathematics, or Biology
Valid JAMB UTME score in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry
programmes.duration: 2 Years (4 Semesters) Full-Time + Mandatory Industrial Training

programmes.name: National Diploma in Statistics
programmes.description: Methodical education in applied statistics, statistical inference, biometric analysis, data analytics, predictive modeling, and econometric computation.
requirements: 5 Credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, and one basic science subject
Two credits chosen from Economics, Geography, Commerce, or Government

programmes.name: National Diploma in Business Administration and Management
programmes.description: Cultivating leadership, corporate enterprise management, marketing, organizational behavior, financial accounting, and entrepreneurial initiative for the modern economy.
requirements: 5 Credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Economics, and two other commercial/arts subjects

programmes.name: National Diploma in Science Laboratory Technology (SLT)
programmes.description: Hands-on laboratory training encompassing chemical instrumentation, microbiological testing, biochemical assays, physical analysis, and clinical diagnostic techniques.
requirements: 5 Credit passes in Mathematics, English Language, Chemistry, Biology/Agricultural Science, and Physics
Pass in UTME relevant science subjects

programmes.name: National Diploma in Civil Engineering Technology
programmes.description: Structural engineering, material testing, surveying, highway design, and water resources management ensuring durable physical infrastructure development.
requirements: 5 Credits in English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Technical Drawing or Biology

announcements.title: Opening of 2026/2027 Academic Session ND Full-Time Admission Portal
announcements.content: The Management of Federal Polytechnic, Ukana hereby invites applications from suitably qualified candidates who sat for the 2026 Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination (UTME) and scored the prescribed national benchmark for admission into National Diploma programmes. Prospective students should review requirements and apply through the designated portal.

announcements.content: Federal Polytechnic, Ukana has received the Tertiary Education Trust Fund (TETFUND) institutional intervention grant aimed at upgrading digital laboratory machinery, solar hybrid research micro-grids, and faculty technological training.

announcements.content: The 2026/2027 Matriculation Ceremony for newly admitted National Diploma candidates will take place at the Polytechnic Auditorium. All registered students are expected to procure their academic gowns from their respective school officers.

admission_info.title: Admission Overview & Academic Calendar
admission_info.content: Federal Polytechnic, Ukana operates an approved National Diploma (ND) curriculum accredited by the National Board for Technical Education (NBTE). The institution admits students annually into accredited schools including School of Applied Sciences, School of Engineering, and School of Business Studies. (DEMO CONTENT - Update with verified institutional figures).

admission_info.title: Eligibility Criteria & UTME Requirements
admission_info.content: Candidates must possess a minimum of five (5) credit passes at SSCE, GCE, NECO, or NABTEB in relevant subjects obtained in not more than two (2) sittings. Candidates must have written the UTME examination and met the polytechnic cut-off threshold. (DEMO CONTENT - Replace with current session cut-off marks).

admission_info.title: Application Step-by-Step Procedure
admission_info.content: 1. Access the Polytechnic Application Portal. 2. Generate a payment Remita Retrieval Reference (RRR) for the screening processing fee. 3. Complete online bio-data and upload O'Level results. 4. Submit print-out acknowledgment slip. 5. Monitor notification of provisional admission offer.

admission_info.title: Required Verification Documents for Screening
admission_info.content: Original and photocopies of: 1. JAMB UTME Result Slip, 2. O'Level Certificate or Statement of Result, 3. Certificate of Origin / LGA Identification, 4. Birth Certificate or Age Declaration, 5. Four recent colored passport photographs.

admission_info.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
admission_info.content: Q: Can I combine two sittings of WAEC and NECO? A: Yes, a combination of two sittings is acceptable for all ND courses. Q: Is on-campus hostel accommodation guaranteed? A: Space is allocated on a first-come, first-served basis through the Student Affairs portal. Q: Where is Federal Polytechnic Ukana located? A: Ukana, Essien Udim LGA, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria.
